next.reason: §2023:12.4.5.3 GR1 keeps 1985 a)-f) (OPTIONAL, ASSIGN consistency, RESERVE, organization, access mode, RELATIVE KEY external item) but adds requirements, among them 'i) The same specification of the FILE STATUS clause, where data-name-4 shall reference the same corresponding external data item', also stated in §2023:14.8.4.2. 1985 allowed different status items per entry: 'The data item referenced by data-name-1 which is updated ... is the one specified in the file control entry associated with that statement' (§1985:VII.2.5.4 GR2). A 1985 program whose entries for one external file name different or no FILE STATUS items is no longer conforming (stricter); l) sharing and m) lock mode add further consistency requirements.
